## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: ci.yml:llm-review calls verify-session-provenance.sh via the wrapper.

## Implementation Notes

Modify `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:

1. Locate the 'Run LLM review' step (currently around line 541, after the 'Suppress prior defenses' step at line 523 modified by S2.T10).
2. Replace the existing `bash plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh` invocation with:
   ```yaml
   - name: Run LLM review (provenance-aware)
     if: needs.changes.outputs.code_changed == 'true'
     env:
       GITHUB_TOKEN: \${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
       ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: \${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
       DSO_BASE_SHA: \${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
       DSO_SESSION_HEAD: \${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
       PR_NUMBER: \${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
     run: bash plugins/dso/scripts/llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh
   ```
3. CRITICAL: do NOT touch line 523's 'Suppress prior defenses' step \xe2\x80\x94 that's S2.T10's edit zone.
4. CRITICAL: preserve the existing env-var passing pattern (DSO_BASE_SHA, DSO_SESSION_HEAD already used by verify-session-provenance.sh per ci.yml:402 inline comment).

After implementation: ci.yml is actionlint-clean. The behavioral test (T4 e2e) will exercise the full pipeline.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| .github/workflows/ci.yml | modify | tests/workflows (existing CI tests) | needs-modification |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ci.yml is actionlint-clean
  Verify: (command -v actionlint >/dev/null && actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml) || python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))"
- [ ] ci.yml invokes the new wrapper
  Verify: grep -q 'llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh' .github/workflows/ci.yml
- [ ] ci.yml no longer directly invokes ci-llm-review-runner.sh from the Run LLM review step (it's now invoked by the wrapper)
  Verify: ! awk '/Run LLM review/,/^      - name:/' .github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -q 'ci-llm-review-runner.sh'
- [ ] S2.T10's edit zone (Suppress prior defenses, ~line 523) not touched by this task
  Verify: true  # manual review at commit time

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.
